The static scanner flagged `workspace.findFiles('**')` as a broad glob pattern. However, in the context of a linter extension, enumerating workspace files to read their content for local static analysis is a standard and expected behavior. There is no evidence of exfiltration or malicious intent associated with this operation.

The static scanner flagged the use of `workspace.findFiles('**')` as a potential broad enumeration. However, in the context of a linter extension, scanning the entire workspace to apply rules is the core intended functionality. This is not malicious behavior.

This is a standard JavaScript method call on a RegExp object, not an invocation of `child_process.exec` or Windows Script Host execution. It is a false positive.
